notes: THIS IS THE SPRING-BRIEF TRAP IN ITS PUREST FORM: three application rounds spread Nov–Mar for a SINGLE autumn cohort. Aggregators (mastersportal, masterstudies, erasmusu) list the programme without dates and invite the inference of a January intake; there is none. Only two official 'máster universitario' titles in Spain are squarely music-business: this one (UPV/Berklee, RUCT 4313420 — autumn only) and UNIR's Gestión Empresarial en la Industria Musical (RUCT 4317068 — March convocatoria, recorded separately in this file). Confirms the field-P conclusion: NO official music-business master in Spain has a spring cohort other than UNIR's.
